alternatives.option: Change PostgreSQL connect timeout default to 5s to match SQL Server.
alternatives.whyRejected: SQL Server uses 5s based on SQL Server database mirroring recommendations; PostgreSQL targeted 2s for fast datacenter failover as documented in resilience.md.

alternatives.option: Remove DefaultConnectTimeout in PgConnectionConfiguration and keep Npgsql default (15s).
alternatives.whyRejected: 15s is too long for high-availability datacenter retry strategies and violates resilience design goals.

fields.consequences: PgConnectionConfiguration applies csb.Timeout = 2 when Timeout is not explicitly set; resilience.md table and text explicitly document 5s (SQL Server) / 2s (PostgreSQL).
fields.context: PgConnectionConfiguration.cs declared DefaultConnectTimeout = 2 but never assigned it, causing unconfigured PostgreSQL connections to use Npgsql 15s default. resilience.md table listed 5s while section text stated 2s.
fields.decision: Apply DefaultConnectTimeout = 2 in PgConnectionConfiguration when props.Timeout is null, and update resilience.md table to clarify provider defaults (5s for SQL Server, 2s for PostgreSQL).
fields.title: B3: Reconcile PostgreSQL Connect Timeout Default and Documentation
